title: New Rules for the Saturday Market
週六市集的新規定
paras: Mr. Tran sold grilled corn at the Saturday market in {{downtown|downtown}} Riverton, one of forty street {{vendor|vendors}}. On Monday morning, he stopped to read a new notice on the door of City Hall. It was a public {{advisory|advisory}} from the city {{authority|authority}} that licensed street stands.
陳先生在里弗頓市中心的週六市集賣烤玉米，是四十位街頭攤販之一。週一早上，他停下來看市政廳門上的新公告。那是負責核發攤位執照的市府主管單位發布的公告。

Starting this weekend, the city would {{prohibit|prohibit}} foam containers at all {{outdoor|outdoor}} markets. It would also {{forbid|forbid}} any stand from blocking a shop entrance. Mr. Tran frowned. He had just bought two thousand foam trays, and his stand sat right in front of a bakery's door.
從這個週末起，市府將禁止所有戶外市集使用保麗龍餐盒，也不准任何攤位擋住店家入口。陳先生皺起眉頭。他才剛買了兩千個保麗龍餐盤，而他的攤位正好就在麵包店門口。

Inside, he found a clerk named Ms. Walker at the permit desk. "Shop owners complained, and the river was full of trash," she explained. "Everyone has to {{abide|abide}} by the rules, or we can't renew their permit. But paper trays are fine, and the city will {{recycle|recycle}} them. There are new bins at every corner." "And my foam trays?" he asked. "Try the restaurants on Pine Street," she said. "Cooks always need trays."
他走進去，在許可證櫃台找到一位名叫沃克的女職員。「店家抱怨過，河裡也都是垃圾，」她解釋，「大家都得遵守規定，否則我們沒辦法讓執照續期。不過紙盤沒問題，市府還會回收，每個角落都會設新的回收桶。」「那我的保麗龍餐盤呢？」他問。「去松樹街問問那些餐廳吧，」她說，「廚房總是缺餐盤。」
On Saturday, Mr. Tran moved his stand six feet down the street, served his corn on paper trays. By noon, the line was longer than ever, and the new bin next to his stand was already half full.
週六，陳先生把攤位往街下方挪了六英尺，改用紙盤裝玉米。到了中午，排隊的人比以往都多，他攤位旁新設的回收桶也已經裝了一半。
